Usage: OpenCADStudio [OPTIONS] [FILES]...

Arguments:
  [FILES]...  CAD files to open at startup (.dwg / .dxf).

Options:
      --new                       Start with a new empty drawing.
      --new-instance              Start a new editor process.
      --read-only                 Open read-only: saving is disabled.
      --backend <BACKEND>         GPU backend (dx12, vulkan, gl, metal). Sets WGPU_BACKEND.
      --safe-mode                 Safe mode: use the GL backend. [alias: --no-gpu]
      --compat-renderer           Use the renderer for GPUs without shader storage buffers.
      --serve                     Run the headless JSON automation server (stdin/stdout, or --port).
      --mcp                       Connect AI clients to the running editor over MCP stdio.
      --sync-mcp-schemas          Export and synchronize AI agent MCP tool schemas to ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp/opencadstudio/ and exit.
      --port <PORT>               TCP port for --serve (defaults to stdin/stdout).
      --http <PORT>               Serve the automation API over REST on http://127.0.0.1:PORT
      --export <IN> <OUT>         Convert IN to OUT using the output file extension, then exit.
      --target-version <VERSION>  Explicit output CAD version for --export (R14, 2000, 2004, 2007, 2010, 2013 or 2018). Without it the source document version is kept
      --allow-lossy               Let --export write an older DWG or DXF target that cannot store some MTEXT data (columns, box height, background mask, line spacing). Without it such an export is refused with exit code 3 and nothing is written
      --script <FILE>             Run a command script at startup, one command per line.
      --batch <SCRIPT>            Run a script with no window, then exit (1 if a row failed).
      --each <SCRIPT>             Run a script on each listed drawing with no window, then exit.
      --log <LEVEL>               Log level (error|warn|info|debug|trace). Also reads RUST_LOG.
  -h, --help                      Print help
  -V, --version                   Print version

import subprocess, json

    }
}
proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(init_req) + '\n')
proc.stdin.flush()

resp = proc.stdout.readline()
print('RESPONSE:', resp)

tools_req = {
    'jsonrpc': '2.0',
    'id': 2,
    'method': 'tools/list',
    'params': {}
}
proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(tools_req) + '\n')
proc.stdin.flush()

resp2 = proc.stdout.readline()
print('TOOLS:', resp2[:500])
proc.kill()
"

import subprocess, json

proc = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/local/bin/OpenCADStudio', '--mcp'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

def call(method, params, id_val):
    req = {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': id_val, 'method': method, 'params': params}
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(req) + '\n')
    proc.stdin.flush()
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())

call('initialize', {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'test', 'version': '1.0'}}, 1)
entities = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_query', 'arguments': {}}, 2)
print('ENTITIES COUNT:', len(entities['result']['structuredContent'].get('entities', [])))
print('ENTITIES:', entities['result']['structuredContent'])
proc.kill()
"

Call record_schema to discover every record type, property path, JSON type, enum, unit, constraint and write rule before editing unfamiliar data. Use records to inspect every serializable entity, object, table, header and document record; filter with RFC 6901 JSON Pointer paths. Use set_properties for atomic, type-checked record edits and preserve document_id, revision and request_id.

import subprocess, json

proc = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/local/bin/OpenCADStudio', '--mcp'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

def call(method, params, id_val):
    req = {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': id_val, 'method': method, 'params': params}
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(req) + '\n')
    proc.stdin.flush()
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())

    print(f'{target} matches:', matches)

proc.kill()

        print(f'Stream {i} sample:', lines[:10])
    except Exception as e:
        pass

    data = f.read()

for i, s in enumerate(streams):
    try:
        decomp = zlib.decompress(s)

            with open(f'/tmp/stream_{i}.txt', 'wb') as out:
                out.write(decomp)
    except Exception:
        pass

    cm_match = re.search(r'([\d\.\-]+)\s+([\d\.\-]+)\s+([\d\.\-]+)\s+([\d\.\-]+)\s+([\d\.\-]+)\s+([\d\.\-]+)\s+cm', b)
    tx, ty = 0.0, 0.0
    if cm_match:
        a, b_rot, c_rot, d, tx, ty = [float(x) for x in cm_match.groups()]
    
    # find m and l
    pts = []
    # first m
    m_match = re.search(r'([\d\.\-]+)\s+([\d\.\-]+)\s+m', b)
    if m_match:
        pts.append((float(m_match.group(1)) + tx, float(m_match.group(2)) + ty))
    # all l
    l_matches = re.findall(r'([\d\.\-]+)\s+([\d\.\-]+)\s+l', b)
    for lx, ly in l_matches:
        pts.append((float(lx) + tx, float(ly) + ty))

# Let's look at the first polyline
print('First polyline (perimeter):', len(all_polys[0]), 'points')
for p in all_polys[0]:
    print(f'  {p}')

import subprocess, json

proc = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/local/bin/OpenCADStudio', '--mcp'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

def call(method, params, id_val):
    req = {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': id_val, 'method': method, 'params': params}

    proc.stdin.flush()
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())

proc = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/local/bin/OpenCADStudio', '--mcp'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

def call(method, params, id_val):
    req = {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': id_val, 'method': method, 'params': params}
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(req) + '\n')
    proc.stdin.flush()
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())

call('initialize', {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'test', 'version': '1.0'}}, 1)
sess = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_sessions', 'arguments': {}}, 2)
sid = sess['result']['structuredContent']['result'][0]['session_id']

r = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_run', 'arguments': {'cmd': '-STYLE \"Legend big\" Arial.ttf 0.004 1.0 0 N N'}}, 3)
print('RUN -STYLE:', r['result'])

# Check text styles
tstyles = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_read', 'arguments': {'ocs_session_id': sid, 'op': 'records', 'parameters': {'collection': 'text_styles'}}}, 4)
styles = [rec['name'] for rec in json.loads(tstyles['result']['content'][0]['text'])['records']]
print('Styles:', [s for s in styles if 'Legend' in s or 'legend' in s])

proc.kill()
"

import subprocess, json

call('initialize', {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'test', 'version': '1.0'}}, 1)

sid = sess['result']['structuredContent']['result'][0]['session_id']

# Switch to Model space
call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_run', 'arguments': {'cmd': 'TILEMODE 1'}}, 3)

r = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_run', 'arguments': {'cmd': 'DIMLINEAR 0,0 10,0 5,2'}}, 4)

# Undo
call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_undo', 'arguments': {}}, 6)

proc.kill()
"

import subprocess, json

proc = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/local/bin/OpenCADStudio', '--mcp'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

def call(method, params, id_val):
    req = {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': id_val, 'method': method, 'params': params}
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(req) + '\n')
    proc.stdin.flush()
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())

call('initialize', {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'test', 'version': '1.0'}}, 1)
sess = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_sessions', 'arguments': {}}, 2)
sid = sess['result']['structuredContent']['result'][0]['session_id']

# check CANNOSCALE sysvar
r = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_execute', 'arguments': {'ocs_session_id': sid, 'request': {'op': 'sysvar', 'request_id': 'sv3', 'get': ['cannoscale']}}}, 3)
print('CANNOSCALE:', r['result'])

proc.kill()
"

import subprocess, json

proc = subprocess.Popen(['/usr/local/bin/OpenCADStudio', '--mcp'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

def call(method, params, id_val):
    req = {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': id_val, 'method': method, 'params': params}
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(req) + '\n')
    proc.stdin.flush()
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())

call('initialize', {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'test', 'version': '1.0'}}, 1)
sess = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_sessions', 'arguments': {}}, 2)
sid = sess['result']['structuredContent']['result'][0]['session_id']

# Open toilet 3.dwg
o = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_open', 'arguments': {'path': '/home/ga/Documents/CAD/Blocks/toilet 3.dwg'}}, 3)
doc_t = o['result']['structuredContent']['state']['document_id']

# Query entities in toilet 3
q = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_query', 'arguments': {}}, 4)
handles = [e['handle'] for e in q['result']['structuredContent']['entities']]
print(f'Toilet 3 has {len(handles)} handles')

# Copy to doc 2
cp = call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_execute', 'arguments': {'ocs_session_id': sid, 'request': {'op': 'entities_copy_to', 'request_id': 'cp_t', 'handles': handles, 'target_document_id': 2}}}, 5)
print('COPY TO DOC 2:', cp['result'])

# Close toilet 3 doc
call('tools/call', {'name': 'ocs_execute', 'arguments': {'ocs_session_id': sid, 'request': {'op': 'close', 'request_id': 'c_t', 'document_id': doc_t, 'discard': True}}}, 6)

proc.kill()
"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import math, json, sys, os, time
from draft_complete import OCSClient

def build():
    c = OCSClient()
    print("OCSClient connected.")

    # 1. Ensure Model space
    c.run('TILEMODE 1')

    # 2. Setup layers
    c.run('-LAYER M walls C 7 walls  M doors C 51 doors  M staircase C 191 staircase  M windows C 2 windows  M text\\ labels C 7 text\\ labels  M dimensions C 81 dimensions  M viewport C 7 viewport P N viewport  ')

    # 3. Text style Standard font to Candara
    c.execute('set_properties', collection='text_styles', name='Standard', updates=[
        {'path': '/font_file', 'value': 'Candara.ttf'},
        {'path': '/true_type_font', 'value': 'Candara'}
    ])

    # 4. Dimension style Annotative meters & DIMLAYER
    c.run('DIMLAYER dimensions')
    c.run('CANNOSCALE 1:200')

    # Now let's draft all geometry for Model space
    entities = []

    # Helper functions for geometry
    def add_line(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Line', 'layer': layer, 'start': [p1[0], p1[1]], 'end': [p2[0], p2[1]]}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_rect(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        x1, y1 = p1
        x2, y2 = p2
        pts = [[x1, y1], [x2, y1], [x2, y2], [x1, y2]]
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': True, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_poly(pts, layer='walls', closed=False, color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': closed, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_arc(center, radius, start_angle, end_angle, layer='doors', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Arc', 'layer': layer, 'center': [center[0], center[1]], 'radius': radius,
               'start_angle_deg': start_angle, 'end_angle_deg': end_angle}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_text(text, pos, height=0.80, layer='text labels', style='Standard'):
        ent = {'type': 'Text', 'layer': layer, 'position': [pos[0], pos[1]], 'height': height, 'value': text, 'style': style}
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_insert(block, pos, scale=1.0, rotation=0.0, layer='0'):
        if isinstance(scale, (int, float)):
            scale_val = scale
        else:
            scale_val = list(scale)
        ent = {'type': 'Insert', 'block': block, 'position': [pos[0], pos[1]], 'scale': scale_val, 'rotation_deg': rotation, 'layer': layer}
        entities.append(ent)

    # ==========================================
    # EXTERIOR WALLS (Thickness 0.30 m)
    # ==========================================
    # Openings along perimeter:
    # 1. Bottom-left wall (y=0.00, inner y=0.30, x from 0 to 3.30):
    # Window: x = 1.14 to 2.50 (w = 1.36)
    add_line([0.00, 0.00], [1.14, 0.00])
    add_line([2.50, 0.00], [3.30, 0.00])
    add_line([0.30, 0.30], [1.14, 0.30])
    add_line([2.50, 0.30], [3.00, 0.30])
    # Window opening jambs:
    add_line([1.14, 0.00], [1.14, 0.30])
    add_line([2.50, 0.00], [2.50, 0.30])
    # Window insert:
    add_insert('windows', [1.14, 0.11], scale=[1.36/0.90, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='windows')

    # Step down at x=3.30:
    add_line([3.30, 0.00], [3.30, -0.45])
    add_line([3.00, 0.30], [3.00, -0.15])

    # 2. Common area south wall (y=-0.45, inner y=-0.15, x from 3.30 to 16.50):
    # Openings:
    # Window 1: 4.75 to 6.11 (1.36)
    # Window 2: 6.84 to 8.20 (1.36)
    # Double door: 9.15 to 10.65 (1.50)
    # Window 3: 11.60 to 12.96 (1.36)
    # Window 4: 13.69 to 15.05 (1.36)
    c_wall_breaks = [
        (3.30, 4.75),
        (6.11, 6.84),
        (8.20, 9.15),
        (10.65, 11.60),
        (12.96, 13.69),
        (15.05, 16.50)
    ]
    for x1, x2 in c_wall_breaks:
        add_line([x1, -0.45], [x2, -0.45])
        # inner line
        ix1 = 3.00 if x1 == 3.30 else x1
        ix2 = 16.20 if x2 == 16.50 else x2
        add_line([ix1, -0.15], [ix2, -0.15])

    for wx1, wx2 in [(4.75, 6.11), (6.84, 8.20), (11.60, 12.96), (13.69, 15.05)]:
        add_line([wx1, -0.45], [wx1, -0.15])
        add_line([wx2, -0.45], [wx2, -0.15])
        add_insert('windows', [wx1, -0.34], scale=[1.36/0.90, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='windows')

    # Double door at 9.15 to 10.65:
    add_line([9.15, -0.45], [9.15, -0.15])
    add_line([10.65, -0.45], [10.65, -0.15])
    # Double door insert (base point is right jamb: [10.65, -0.45])
    add_insert('double door', [10.65, -0.45], scale=1.0, rotation=0.0, layer='doors')

    # Step up at x=16.50:
    add_line([16.50, -0.45], [16.50, 1.80])
    add_line([16.20, -0.15], [16.20, 2.10])

    # 3. Office bottom wall (y=1.80, inner y=2.10, x from 16.50 to 21.25):
    # Window 1: 17.00 to 18.36 (1.36)
    # Window 2: 18.96 to 19.86 (0.90)
    off_breaks = [
        (16.50, 17.00),
        (18.36, 18.96),
        (19.86, 21.25)
    ]
    for x1, x2 in off_breaks:
        add_line([x1, 1.80], [x2, 1.80])
        ix1 = 16.20 if x1 == 16.50 else x1
        add_line([ix1, 2.10], [x2, 2.10])
    add_line([17.00, 1.80], [17.00, 2.10])
    add_line([18.36, 1.80], [18.36, 2.10])
    add_insert('windows', [17.00, 1.91], scale=[1.36/0.90, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='windows')
    add_line([18.96, 1.80], [18.96, 2.10])
    add_line([19.86, 1.80], [19.86, 2.10])
    add_insert('windows', [18.96, 1.91], scale=[1.0, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='windows')

    # Central entrance angled returns:
    # Office side: 45 deg from [21.25, 1.80] to [21.65, 2.20]
    add_line([21.25, 1.80], [21.65, 2.20])
    add_line([21.25, 2.10], [21.44, 2.29]) # inner line
    # Vertical wall segment of entrance:
    add_line([21.65, 2.20], [21.65, 3.65])
    add_line([21.35, 2.20], [21.35, 3.65]) # inner

    # Laundry side angled returns:
    add_line([22.75, 2.20], [23.15, 1.80])
    add_line([22.96, 2.29], [23.15, 2.10])
    add_line([22.75, 2.20], [22.75, 3.65])
    add_line([23.05, 2.20], [23.05, 3.65])

    # Double door at central exterior entrance (width 1.50: x=21.65 to 23.15 or 21.45 to 22.95)
    # In reference: double door across opening between [21.65, 2.20] and [22.75, 2.20] (or 1.40 opening):
    add_insert('double door', [22.75, 2.20], scale=[1.10/1.40, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='doors')
    # Another double door at corridor connection [21.65, 3.65] to [22.75, 3.65]
    add_insert('double door', [22.75, 3.65], scale=[1.10/1.40, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='doors')

    # 4. Laundry / Stairs / Unit 7 bottom wall (y=1.80, inner y=2.10, x from 23.15 to 30.10):
    # Windows:
    # Window 1 (laundry): 23.63 to 24.53 (0.90)
    # Window 2 (stairs): 25.65 to 27.01 (1.36)
    # Window 3 (unit 7): 28.05 to 29.41 (1.36)
    lau_breaks = [
        (23.15, 23.63),
        (24.53, 25.65),
        (27.01, 28.05),
        (29.41, 30.10)
    ]
    for x1, x2 in lau_breaks:
        add_line([x1, 1.80], [x2, 1.80])
        ix2 = 29.80 if x2 == 30.10 else x2
        add_line([x1, 2.10], [ix2, 2.10])

    for wx1, wx2, is_09 in [(23.63, 24.53, True), (25.65, 27.01, False), (28.05, 29.41, False)]:
        add_line([wx1, 1.80], [wx1, 2.10])
        add_line([wx2, 1.80], [wx2, 2.10])
        sc = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] if is_09 else [1.36/0.90, 1.0, 1.0]
        add_insert('windows', [wx1, 1.91], scale=sc, rotation=0.0, layer='windows')

    # Step down at x=30.10:
    add_line([30.10, 1.80], [30.10, 1.35])
    add_line([29.80, 2.10], [29.80, 1.65])

    # 5. Unit 5 bottom wall (y=1.35, inner y=1.65, x from 30.10 to 38.30):
    # Windows:
    # Window 1: 31.65 to 33.01 (1.36)
    # Window 2: 35.50 to 36.86 (1.36)
    u5_breaks = [
        (30.10, 31.65),
        (33.01, 35.50),
        (36.86, 38.30)
    ]
    for x1, x2 in u5_breaks:
        add_line([x1, 1.35], [x2, 1.35])
        ix1 = 29.80 if x1 == 30.10 else x1
        ix2 = 38.00 if x2 == 38.30 else x2
        add_line([ix1, 1.65], [ix2, 1.65])

    for wx1, wx2 in [(31.65, 33.01), (35.50, 36.86)]:
        add_line([wx1, 1.35], [wx1, 1.65])
        add_line([wx2, 1.35], [wx2, 1.65])
        add_insert('windows', [wx1, 1.46], scale=[1.36/0.90, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='windows')

    # 6. Right exterior wall (x=38.30, inner x=38.00, y from 1.35 to 11.70):
    # Windows (0.90 m each):
    # 3.90 to 4.80
    # 5.50 to 6.40
    # 6.79 to 7.69
    # 8.10 to 9.00
    r_breaks = [
        (1.35, 3.90),
        (4.80, 5.50),
        (6.40, 6.79),
        (7.69, 8.10),
        (9.00, 11.70)
    ]
    for y1, y2 in r_breaks:
        add_line([38.30, y1], [38.30, y2])
        iy1 = 1.65 if y1 == 1.35 else y1
        iy2 = 11.40 if y2 == 11.70 else y2
        add_line([38.00, iy1], [38.00, iy2])

    for wy1, wy2 in [(3.90, 4.80), (5.50, 6.40), (6.79, 7.69), (8.10, 9.00)]:
        add_line([38.30, wy1], [38.00, wy1])
        add_line([38.30, wy2], [38.00, wy2])
        # Vertical window insertion (rotated 90 deg)
        add_insert('windows', [38.19, wy1], scale=[1.0, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=90.0, layer='windows')

    # 7. Top wall units 4 & 3 (y=11.70, inner y=11.40, x from 30.10 to 38.30):
    # Windows:
    # 31.65 to 33.01 (1.36)
    # 35.50 to 36.86 (1.36)
    u43_breaks = [
        (30.10, 31.65),
        (33.01, 35.50),
        (36.86, 38.30)
    ]
    for x1, x2 in u43_breaks:
        add_line([x1, 11.70], [x2, 11.70])
        ix1 = 30.40 if x1 == 30.10 else x1
        ix2 = 38.00 if x2 == 38.30 else x2
        add_line([ix1, 11.40], [ix2, 11.40])

    for wx1, wx2 in [(31.65, 33.01), (35.50, 36.86)]:
        add_line([wx1, 11.70], [wx1, 11.40])
        add_line([wx2, 11.70], [wx2, 11.40])
        add_insert('windows', [wx1, 11.51], scale=[1.36/0.90, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='windows')

    # Step down at x=30.10:
    add_line([30.10, 11.70], [30.10, 10.95])
    add_line([30.40, 11.40], [30.40, 10.65])

    # 8. Unit 2 top wall (y=10.95, inner y=10.65, x from 25.40 to 30.10):
    # Windows (0.90 m each):
    # 26.60 to 27.50
    # 28.00 to 28.90
    u2_breaks = [
        (25.40, 26.60),
        (27.50, 28.00),
        (28.90, 30.10)
    ]
    for x1, x2 in u2_breaks:
        add_line([x1, 10.95], [x2, 10.95])

        p_chamf_1 = [base_x + 1.15*sx, base_y + 1.00*sy]
        p_chamf_2 = [base_x + 1.40*sx, base_y + 0.75*sy]
        p_wall_end = [base_x + 1.40*sx, base_y]

        add_line(p_chamf_1, p_chamf_2)
        add_line(p_chamf_2, p_wall_end)
        
        # Double-line thickness (0.10 m inward):
        t = 0.10
        add_line([p_door_end[0], p_door_end[1] - t*sy], [p_chamf_1[0] - t*sx*0.414, p_chamf_1[1] - t*sy])

    c.run('TILEMODE 1')

    # 2. Setup layers
    c.run('-LAYER M walls C 7 walls  M doors C 51 doors  M staircase C 191 staircase  M windows C 2 windows  M text\\ labels C 7 text\\ labels  M dimensions C 81 dimensions  M viewport C 7 viewport P N viewport  ')

    # 3. Text style Standard font to Candara
    c.execute('set_properties', collection='text_styles', name='Standard', updates=[
        {'path': '/font_file', 'value': 'Candara.ttf'},
        {'path': '/true_type_font', 'value': 'Candara'}
    ])

    # 4. Dimension style Annotative meters & DIMLAYER
    c.run('DIMLAYER dimensions')
    c.run('CANNOSCALE 1:200')

    # Now let's draft all geometry for Model space
    entities = []

    # Helper functions for geometry
    def add_line(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Line', 'layer': layer, 'start': [p1[0], p1[1]], 'end': [p2[0], p2[1]]}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_rect(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        x1, y1 = p1
        x2, y2 = p2
        pts = [[x1, y1], [x2, y1], [x2, y2], [x1, y2]]
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': True, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_poly(pts, layer='walls', closed=False, color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': closed, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_arc(center, radius, start_angle, end_angle, layer='doors', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Arc', 'layer': layer, 'center': [center[0], center[1]], 'radius': radius,
               'start_angle_deg': start_angle, 'end_angle_deg': end_angle}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_text(text, pos, height=0.80, layer='text labels', style='Standard'):
        ent = {'type': 'Text', 'layer': layer, 'position': [pos[0], pos[1]], 'height': height, 'value': text, 'style': style}
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_insert(block, pos, scale=1.0, rotation=0.0, layer='0'):
        if isinstance(scale, (int, float)):
            scale_val = scale
        else:
            scale_val = list(scale)

        add_line(p_chamf_2, p_wall_end)
        
        # Double-line thickness (0.10 m inward):
        t = 0.10
        add_line([p_door_end[0], p_door_end[1] - t*sy], [p_chamf_1[0] - t*sx*0.414, p_chamf_1[1] - t*sy])
        add_line([p_chamf_1[0] - t*sx*0.414, p_chamf_1[1] - t*sy], [p_chamf_2[0] - t*sx, p_chamf_2[1] - t*sy*0.414])

    add_restroom(34.25, 3.75, flip_x=False, flip_y=True)

    # ==========================================
    # STAIRCASES (Layer: staircase, Color Index 191)

    # 1. Left staircase (in room x = 14.80 to 17.20, y = 2.20 to 6.25):

    stair_x1 = 14.90
    stair_x2 = 16.00 # width 1.10
    stair_y0 = 2.40
    for i in range(9): # 8 treads + 1
        y = stair_y0 + i * 0.25
        add_line([stair_x1, y], [stair_x2, y], layer='staircase')
    # Bounding flight lines:
    add_line([stair_x1, stair_y0], [stair_x1, stair_y0 + 8*0.25], layer='staircase')
    add_line([stair_x2, stair_y0], [stair_x2, stair_y0 + 8*0.25], layer='staircase')

    add_line([stair_x2 + 0.10, stair_y0 + 8*0.25], [stair_x2 + 0.10, 5.80], layer='staircase')
    add_line([stair_x1, 5.80], [stair_x2 + 0.10, 5.80], layer='staircase')

    add_line([cstair_x1, 5.80], [cstair_x2 + 0.10, 5.80], layer='staircase')
    add_poly([[cstair_x1, cstair_y0 + 4*0.25 - 0.10], [cstair_x1 + 0.50, cstair_y0 + 4*0.25 + 0.10], [cstair_x1 + 0.60, cstair_y0 + 4*0.25 - 0.10], [cstair_x2, cstair_y0 + 4*0.25 + 0.10]], layer='staircase')

    # ==========================================
    # ROOM DESIGNATION LABELS (Layer: text labels, Candara, height 0.80)
    # ==========================================
    labels = [
        ('dinning area', [6.0, 11.8]),
        ('kitchen', [18.0, 9.2]),
        ('common area', [7.5, 4.5]),
        ('office', [18.5, 3.4]),

        ('stairs', [25.8, 2.5]),
        ('unit 1', [22.0, 9.5]),
        ('unit 2', [26.8, 9.2]),
        ('unit 3', [31.5, 9.5]),
        ('unit 4', [35.2, 9.5]),
        ('unit 5', [35.2, 2.6]),
        ('unit 6', [31.8, 3.4]),

    # ==========================================
    # DETAIL VIEWS IN MODEL SPACE

    # 1. Door Detail at offset [50, 0]:
    # Single door standard geometry
    det_door_x, det_door_y = 50.0, 0.0
    add_poly([[det_door_x, det_door_y], [det_door_x + 0.05, det_door_y], [det_door_x + 0.05, det_door_y + 0.10], [det_door_x, det_door_y + 0.10]], layer='doors', closed=True)
    add_poly([[det_door_x + 0.95, det_door_y], [det_door_x + 1.00, det_door_y], [det_door_x + 1.00, det_door_y + 0.10], [det_door_x + 0.95, det_door_y + 0.10]], layer='doors', closed=True)
    add_line([det_door_x + 0.05, det_door_y + 0.10], [det_door_x + 0.05, det_door_y + 1.00], layer='doors')
    add_arc([det_door_x + 0.05, det_door_y + 0.10], 0.90, 0.0, 90.0, layer='doors')

    # 2. Window / Profile Detail at offset [60, 0]:
    # 0.30 m wall profile with 0.90 m window
    det_win_x, det_win_y = 60.0, 0.0
    # Wall profile (0.30 m thickness):
    add_rect([det_win_x - 0.20, det_win_y], [det_win_x, det_win_y + 0.30], layer='walls') # left wall segment
    add_rect([det_win_x + 0.90, det_win_y], [det_win_x + 1.10, det_win_y + 0.30], layer='walls') # right wall segment
    # Window frame: 0.90 m wide by 0.08 m depth, positioned 0.05 m from outer wall face
    w_fy = det_win_y + 0.05
    add_rect([det_win_x, w_fy], [det_win_x + 0.90, w_fy + 0.08], layer='windows')
    add_line([det_win_x + 0.05, w_fy], [det_win_x + 0.05, w_fy + 0.08], layer='windows')
    add_line([det_win_x + 0.85, w_fy], [det_win_x + 0.85, w_fy + 0.08], layer='windows')
    add_line([det_win_x + 0.05, w_fy + 0.02], [det_win_x + 0.85, w_fy + 0.02], layer='windows')
    add_line([det_win_x + 0.05, w_fy + 0.06], [det_win_x + 0.85, w_fy + 0.06], layer='windows')

    print(f"Total entities to create: {len(entities)}")
    created = c.create_entities(entities)
    print(f"Successfully created {len(created)} entities in Model space!")

    c.close()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import math, json, sys, os, time
from draft_complete import OCSClient

def build():
    c = OCSClient()
    print("OCSClient connected.")

    # 1. Ensure Model space
    c.run('TILEMODE 1')

    # 2. Setup layers
    c.run('-LAYER M walls C 7 walls  M doors C 51 doors  M staircase C 191 staircase  M windows C 2 windows  M text\\ labels C 7 text\\ labels  M dimensions C 81 dimensions  M viewport C 7 viewport P N viewport  ')

    # 3. Text style Standard font to Candara
    c.execute('set_properties', collection='text_styles', name='Standard', updates=[
        {'path': '/font_file', 'value': 'Candara.ttf'},
        {'path': '/true_type_font', 'value': 'Candara'}
    ])

    # 4. Dimension style Annotative meters & DIMLAYER
    c.run('DIMLAYER dimensions')
    c.run('CANNOSCALE 1:200')

    # Now let's draft all geometry for Model space
    entities = []

    # Helper functions for geometry
    def add_line(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Line', 'layer': layer, 'start': [p1[0], p1[1]], 'end': [p2[0], p2[1]]}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_rect(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        x1, y1 = p1
        x2, y2 = p2
        pts = [[x1, y1], [x2, y1], [x2, y2], [x1, y2]]
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': True, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_poly(pts, layer='walls', closed=False, color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': closed, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_arc(center, radius, start_angle, end_angle, layer='doors', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Arc', 'layer': layer, 'center': [center[0], center[1]], 'radius': radius,
               'start_angle_deg': start_angle, 'end_angle_deg': end_angle}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_text(text, pos, height=0.80, layer='text labels', style='Standard'):
        ent = {'type': 'Text', 'layer': layer, 'position': [pos[0], pos[1]], 'height': height, 'value': text, 'style': style}
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_insert(block, pos, scale=1.0, rotation=0.0, layer='0'):
        if isinstance(scale, (int, float)):
            scale_val = scale
        else:
            scale_val = list(scale)
        ent = {'type': 'Insert', 'block': block, 'position': [pos[0], pos[1]], 'scale': scale_val, 'rotation_deg': rotation, 'layer': layer}
        entities.append(ent)

    # ==========================================
    # EXTERIOR WALLS (Thickness 0.30 m)
    # ==========================================
    # Openings along perimeter:
    # 1. Bottom-left wall (y=0.00, inner y=0.30, x from 0 to 3.30):
    # Window: x = 1.14 to 2.50 (w = 1.36)
    add_line([0.00, 0.00], [1.14, 0.00])
    add_line([2.50, 0.00], [3.30, 0.00])
    add_line([0.30, 0.30], [1.14, 0.30])
    add_line([2.50, 0.30], [3.00, 0.30])
    # Window opening jambs:
    add_line([1.14, 0.00], [1.14, 0.30])
    add_line([2.50, 0.00], [2.50, 0.30])
    # Window insert:
    add_insert('windows', [1.14, 0.11], scale=[1.36/0.90, 1.0, 1.0], rotation=0.0, layer='windows')

    # Step down at x=3.30:
    add_line([3.30, 0.00], [3.30, -0.45])
    add_line([3.00, 0.30], [3.00, -0.15])

    # 2. Common area south wall (y=-0.45, inner y=-0.15, x from 3.30 to 16.50):
    # Openings:
    # Window 1: 4.75 to 6.11 (1.36)
    # Window 2: 6.84 to 8.20 (1.36)
    # Double door: 9.15 to 10.65 (1.50)
    # Window 3: 11.60 to 12.96 (1.36)
    # Window 4: 13.69 to 15.05 (1.36)
    c_wall_breaks = [
        (3.30, 4.75),
        (6.11, 6.84),
        (8.20, 9.15),
        (10.65, 11.60),
        (12.96, 13.69),
        (15.05, 16.50)
    ]
    for x1, x2 in c_wall_breaks:
        add_line([x1, -0.45], [x2, -0.45])
        # inner line
        ix1 = 3.00 if x1 == 3.30 else x1

proc.kill()

718:     pub(super) fn camera_for_viewport(&self, vp_handle: Handle) -> Option<view::camera::Camera> {
 719:         let vp = match self.document.get_entity(vp_handle) {
 720:             Some(EntityType::Viewport(vp)) => vp,
 721:             _ => return None,
 722:         };
 723: 
 724:         // Floating-viewport–specific step: decide saved-view vs auto-fit, then
 725:         // hand the effective view to the shared `camera_from_view` decoder so
 726:         // twist / view_center / distance behave identically to a model VPORT.
 727:         //
 728:         // UTM / coordinate-shifted drawings often arrive with
 729:         // `view_target = (0, 0, 0)` and a stale `view_center` from before the
 730:         // file was geo-referenced; the saved view points at empty WCS while the
 731:         // actual model sits ~`world_offset` away. Decode the saved view first
 732:         // and keep it only if its target actually frames the model cluster.
 733:         //
 734:         // The overlap test runs on the *decoded* target (wire-space, so the
 735:         // cluster is `±cluster_half` about the origin), NOT a raw
 736:         // `view_target + view_center` sum: under a view twist `view_center` is a
 737:         // DCS offset, so the raw sum lands far from the real WCS centre and
 738:         // would wrongly trip the auto-fit — replacing the saved view_height with
 739:         // the whole-cluster fit and rendering the content at the wrong zoom.
 740:         let saved_h = vp.view_height.abs();
 741:         let aspect_d = (vp.width / vp.height.max(1.0)).max(1e-9);
 742:         let cluster_half = self.local_extent_max.max(1.0) as f64;
 743:         // Full model-space bounds. The overlap test below accepts the saved view
 744:         // when its frame touches ANY drawn geometry — not just the dense median
 745:         // cluster (`local_center ± cluster_half`). A drawing with a second,
 746:         // sparser cluster (e.g. model-documentation view geometry sitting apart
 747:         // from a big symbol library) has viewports legitimately aimed at that
 748:         // second cluster; testing only the dense one wrongly auto-fits them onto
 749:         // the library. Fall back to the cluster box when no extents are known.
 750:         let full_bounds = self
 751:             .model_space_extents()
 752:             .map(|(mn, mx)| (mn.x as f64, mn.y as f64, mx.x as f64, mx.y as f64));
 753:         // Absolute drawing centre. Geometry now reaches the scene at absolute
 754:         // (UTM) coordinates — the old code centred the overlap test and the
 755:         // auto-fit on the origin, which was right only while world_offset
 756:         // re-centred the model there. Without it a UTM drawing sits ~5.7e6 away,
 757:         // so a stale `(0,0,0)` saved view failed the overlap test AND the
 758:         // auto-fit aimed at empty origin → blank viewports.
 759:         // Frame the overlap test / auto-fit on the robust cluster centre (median
 760:         // of entity centroids), NOT the raw extents centre: a drawing with a
 761:         // far second cluster (e.g. a small-coordinate legend beside a UTM survey)
 762:         // has an extents centre in the empty gap, which would reject a valid
 763:         // saved view and then auto-fit onto blank space. Fall back to the extents
 764:         // centre only when no cluster centre was computed.
 765:         let (cx, cy) = if self.local_center != [0.0, 0.0] {
 766:             (self.local_center[0], self.local_center[1])
 767:         } else {
 768:             self.model_space_extents()
 769:                 .map(|(mn, mx)| (((mn.x + mx.x) * 0.5) as f64, ((mn.y + mx.y) * 0.5) as f64))
 770:                 .unwrap_or((0.0, 0.0))
 771:         };
 772:

1005:     pub(super) fn camera_from_view_mode(
1006:         &self,
1007:         view_direction: document::types::Vector3,
1008:         view_target: document::types::Vector3,
1009:         view_center: document::types::Vector2,
1010:         view_height: f64,
1011:         twist: f64,
1012:         perspective: bool,
1013:         lens_length: f64,
1014:     ) -> Option<Camera> {
1015:         if view_height.abs() < 1e-9 {
1016:             return None;
1017:         }
1018:         let vd = glam::Vec3::new(
1019:             view_direction.x as f32,
1020:             view_direction.y as f32,
1021:             view_direction.z as f32,
1022:         )
1023:         .normalize_or(glam::Vec3::Z);
1024:         let pitch = vd.z.clamp(-1.0, 1.0).asin();
1025:         // view_dir = (sin(yaw)*cos(pitch), -cos(yaw)*cos(pitch), sin(pitch))
1026:         // → yaw = atan2(x, -y), but when looking straight up/down cos(pitch)≈0
1027:         //   both x and y are near zero and atan2(0, -0.0) = π due to IEEE 754.
1028:         let yaw = if vd.x.abs() < 1e-6 && vd.y.abs() < 1e-6 {
1029:             0.0_f32 // plan/nadir view: yaw is undefined, default to 0
1030:         } else {
1031:             vd.x.atan2(-vd.y)
1032:         };
1033:         // The saved view can carry a twist (rotation about the view axis), set
1034:         // when the view was aligned to a rotated UCS. The twist is the angle
1035:         // that rotates world-X onto screen-right, so the world direction that
1036:         // ends up horizontal is its negative; feed that in as the camera roll
1037:         // so the drawing opens square, the way it was saved, instead of in raw
1038:         // world orientation (which looks tilted).
1039:         let rotation = view::camera::yaw_pitch_to_quat(yaw, pitch, -twist as f32);
1040:         // view_target is WCS; wire-space subtracts world_offset. view_center is
1041:         // a DCS (screen-plane) offset, so fold it through the view basis.
1042:         // Keep the target in f64: casting it to f32 first quantizes the camera
1043:         // to ~0.5 m at UTM scale, so panning/zooming inside a floating viewport
1044:         // (which nudges view_target by sub-metre f64 steps) made the content
1045:         // jump on the f32 grid.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import math, json, sys, os, time
from master_draft import OCS

def run_build():
    ocs = OCS()
    print("OCS connection established.")

    # 1. Switch to Model space
    ocs.run('TILEMODE 1')

    # 2. Configure layers
    ocs.run('-LAYER M walls C 7 walls  M doors C 51 doors  M staircase C 191 staircase  M windows C 2 windows  M text\\ labels C 7 text\\ labels  M dimensions C 81 dimensions  M viewport C 7 viewport P N viewport  ')

    # 3. Configure text style Standard to Candara
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='text_styles', name='Standard', updates=[
        {'path': '/font_file', 'value': 'Candara.ttf'},
        {'path': '/true_type_font', 'value': 'Candara'}
    ])

    # 4. Set DIMLAYER to dimensions
    ocs.run('DIMLAYER dimensions')

    # 5. Clear existing Model space entities if needed (keep Paper space)
    q_mod = ocs.query(limit=500)
    del_handles = [e['handle'] for e in q_mod.get('structuredContent', {}).get('entities', []) 
                   if e.get('space') == '*Model_Space']
    if del_handles:
        print(f"Clearing {len(del_handles)} existing Model space entities...")
        # delete in chunks
        for i in range(0, len(del_handles), 50):
            ocs.execute('entities_delete', handles=del_handles[i:i+50])

    # 6. Author reusable block toilet
    # First check if block toilet already exists
    blocks_rec = ocs.read_records('block_records')
    b_names = [r['name'] for r in json.loads(blocks_rec['content'][0]['text'])['records']]
    if 'toilet' not in b_names:
        print("Authoring reusable block 'toilet'...")
        # Create enclosure and fixture entities
        t_ents = [
            # Outer chamfered enclosure
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.00, 1.00], 'end': [1.15, 1.00]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.15, 1.00], 'end': [1.40, 0.75]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.40, 0.75], 'end': [1.40, 0.00]},
            # Inner chamfered enclosure (0.10 m thickness)
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.00, 0.90], 'end': [1.11, 0.90]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.11, 0.90], 'end': [1.30, 0.71]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.30, 0.71], 'end': [1.30, 0.00]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.00, 1.00], 'end': [1.00, 0.90]},
            # Door standard at entrance
            {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'door standard', 'position': [0.0, 1.00], 'scale': 1.0, 'rotation_deg': 0.0, 'layer': 'doors'},
            # Fixtures
            {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'toilet 3', 'position': [0.35, 0.20], 'scale': 1.0, 'rotation_deg': 0.0, 'layer': 'Furnitures'},
            {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'sink 8', 'position': [0.90, 0.20], 'scale': 1.0, 'rotation_deg': 0.0, 'layer': 'Furnitures'}
        ]
        created_t = ocs.create_entities(t_ents)
        bd = ocs.execute('block_define', name='toilet', handles=created_t, base=[0, 0])
        # delete replacement insert
        ins_h = bd.get('structuredContent', {}).get('result', {}).get('insert')
        if ins_h:
            ocs.execute('entities_delete', handles=[ins_h])

    print("Blocks ready.")

    # 7. Model space geometry
    entities = []

    def add_line(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Line', 'layer': layer, 'start': [p1[0], p1[1]], 'end': [p2[0], p2[1]]}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_rect(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        pts = [[p1[0], p1[1]], [p2[0], p1[1]], [p2[0], p2[1]], [p1[0], p2[1]]]
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': True, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_poly(pts, layer='walls', closed=False, color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': closed, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_arc(center, radius, start_angle, end_angle, layer='doors', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Arc', 'layer': layer, 'center': [center[0], center[1]], 'radius': radius,
               'start_angle_deg': start_angle, 'end_angle_deg': end_angle}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import math, json, sys, os, time
from master_draft import OCS

def run_build():
    ocs = OCS()
    print("OCS connection established.")

    # 1. Switch to Model space
    ocs.run('TILEMODE 1')

    # 2. Configure layers
    ocs.run('-LAYER M walls C 7 walls  M doors C 51 doors  M staircase C 191 staircase  M windows C 2 windows  M text\\ labels C 7 text\\ labels  M dimensions C 81 dimensions  M viewport C 7 viewport P N viewport  ')

    # 3. Configure text style Standard to Candara
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='text_styles', name='Standard', updates=[
        {'path': '/font_file', 'value': 'Candara.ttf'},
        {'path': '/true_type_font', 'value': 'Candara'}
    ])

    # 4. Set DIMLAYER to dimensions
    ocs.run('DIMLAYER dimensions')

    # 5. Clear existing Model space entities if needed (keep Paper space)
    q_mod = ocs.query(limit=500)
    del_handles = [e['handle'] for e in q_mod.get('structuredContent', {}).get('entities', []) 
                   if e.get('space') == '*Model_Space']
    if del_handles:
        print(f"Clearing {len(del_handles)} existing Model space entities...")
        # delete in chunks
        for i in range(0, len(del_handles), 50):
            ocs.execute('entities_delete', handles=del_handles[i:i+50])

    # 6. Author reusable block toilet
    # First check if block toilet already exists
    blocks_rec = ocs.read_records('block_records')
    b_names = [r['name'] for r in json.loads(blocks_rec['content'][0]['text'])['records']]
    if 'toilet' not in b_names:
        print("Authoring reusable block 'toilet'...")
        # Create enclosure and fixture entities
        t_ents = [
            # Outer chamfered enclosure
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.00, 1.00], 'end': [1.15, 1.00]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.15, 1.00], 'end': [1.40, 0.75]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.40, 0.75], 'end': [1.40, 0.00]},
            # Inner chamfered enclosure (0.10 m thickness)
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.00, 0.90], 'end': [1.11, 0.90]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.11, 0.90], 'end': [1.30, 0.71]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.30, 0.71], 'end': [1.30, 0.00]},
            {'type': 'Line', 'layer': 'walls', 'start': [1.00, 1.00], 'end': [1.00, 0.90]},
            # Door standard at entrance
            {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'door standard', 'position': [0.0, 1.00], 'scale': 1.0, 'rotation_deg': 0.0, 'layer': 'doors'},
            # Fixtures
            {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'toilet 3', 'position': [0.35, 0.20], 'scale': 1.0, 'rotation_deg': 0.0, 'layer': 'Furnitures'},
            {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'sink 8', 'position': [0.90, 0.20], 'scale': 1.0, 'rotation_deg': 0.0, 'layer': 'Furnitures'}
        ]
        created_t = ocs.create_entities(t_ents)
        bd = ocs.execute('block_define', name='toilet', handles=created_t, base=[0, 0])
        # delete replacement insert
        ins_h = bd.get('structuredContent', {}).get('result', {}).get('insert')
        if ins_h:
            ocs.execute('entities_delete', handles=[ins_h])

    print("Blocks ready.")

    # 7. Model space geometry
    entities = []

    def add_line(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        ent = {'type': 'Line', 'layer': layer, 'start': [p1[0], p1[1]], 'end': [p2[0], p2[1]]}
        if color is not None:
            ent['color'] = color
        entities.append(ent)

    def add_rect(p1, p2, layer='walls', color=None):
        pts = [[p1[0], p1[1]], [p2[0], p1[1]], [p2[0], p2[1]], [p1[0], p2[1]]]
        ent = {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': layer, 'closed': True, 'vertices': pts}
        if color is not None:

import math, json, sys, os, time

def run_build():
    ocs = OCS()

    # 1. Switch to Model space

    # 2. Configure layers

    # 3. Configure text style Standard to Candara
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='text_styles', name='Standard', updates=[
        {'path': '/font_file', 'value': 'Candara.ttf'},
        {'path': '/true_type_font', 'value': 'Candara'}
    ])

    # 4. Set DIMLAYER to dimensions
    ocs.run('DIMLAYER dimensions')

    # 5. Clear existing Model space entities if needed (keep Paper space)
    q_mod = ocs.query(limit=500)
    del_handles = [e['handle'] for e in q_mod.get('structuredContent', {}).get('entities', []) 
                   if e.get('space') == '*Model_Space']
    if del_handles:
        print(f"Clearing {len(del_handles)} existing Model space entities...")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, sys, os, time
from master_draft import OCS

def finish():
    ocs = OCS()
    print("Connected to OCS.")

    # ==========================================
    # 1. SETUP LAYOUT1
    # ==========================================
    print("Configuring Layout1...")
    ocs.run('-LAYOUT S Layout1')
    ocs.execute('page_setup_set', layout='Layout1', paper='A4', orientation='Landscape', scale='1000:1')

    # Add sheet border and title block texts in *Paper_Space
    l1_ents = [
        # Sheet border
        {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': '0', 'closed': True, 'vertices': [[0.010, 0.008], [0.287, 0.008], [0.287, 0.202], [0.010, 0.202]]},
        # Title block texts
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.051], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Project: Example 1'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.038], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Location:'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.025], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Drawing name: Ground floor'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.224, 0.014], 'height': 0.0025, 'value': '1:200'}
    ]
    ocs.create_entities(l1_ents)

    # Check viewports in Layout1
    q1 = ocs.query(limit=50)
    vps1 = [e['handle'] for e in q1.get('structuredContent', {}).get('entities', []) 
            if e.get('space') == '*Paper_Space' and e.get('type') == 'Viewport']
    print(f"Layout1 viewports: {vps1}")
    # We want exactly one sheet viewport (id=1) and one content viewport (id=2)
    # If more than 2, delete extra content viewports; if only 1, create content viewport
    if len(vps1) == 1:
        r = ocs.run('MVIEW 0.010,0.010 0.280,0.200')
        content_vp1 = r['structuredContent']['changes'][0]['handle']
    else:
        content_vp1 = vps1[-1]

    print(f"Setting properties on Layout1 content viewport {content_vp1}...")
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='entities', handle=content_vp1, updates=[
        {'path': '/center/x', 'value': 0.148},
        {'path': '/center/y', 'value': 0.110},
        {'path': '/width', 'value': 0.270},
        {'path': '/height', 'value': 0.175},
        {'path': '/view_target/x', 'value': 19.15},
        {'path': '/view_target/y', 'value': 6.20},
        {'path': '/view_target/z', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/x', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/y', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_height', 'value': 35.0},
        {'path': '/custom_scale', 'value': 0.005},
        {'path': '/common/layer', 'value': 'viewport'}
    ])
    ocs.select(handles=[content_vp1])
    ocs.execute('property', field='frozen_layers', value='Furnitures')

    # Zoom window on Layout1 to frame sheet nicely
    ocs.run('ZOOM W 0,0 0.30,0.22')

    # ==========================================
    # 2. SETUP DETAILS SHEET
    # ==========================================
    print("Configuring details layout...")
    ocs.run('-LAYOUT S details')
    ocs.execute('page_setup_set', layout='details', paper='A4', orientation='Landscape', scale='1000:1')

    # Add sheet border, title block table lines and text in *Paper_Space0
    det_ents = [
        # Sheet border
        {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': '0', 'closed': True, 'vertices': [[0.010, 0.008], [0.287, 0.008], [0.287, 0.202], [0.010, 0.202]]},
        # Title block table lines
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.008], 'end': [0.205, 0.060]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.287, 0.008], 'end': [0.287, 0.060]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.008], 'end': [0.287, 0.008]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.022], 'end': [0.287, 0.022]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.034], 'end': [0.287, 0.034]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.047], 'end': [0.287, 0.047]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.060], 'end': [0.287, 0.060]},
        # Block Drawn Scale Date
        {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'Drawn Scale Date', 'position': [0.209, 0.020], 'scale': 1.0, 'layer': '0'},
        # Title block text
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.051], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Project: Example 1'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.038], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Location:'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.025], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Drawing name: Details'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.224, 0.014], 'height': 0.0025, 'value': 'As shown'}
    ]
    ocs.create_entities(det_ents)

    # Check viewports in details layout
    q2 = ocs.query(limit=50)
    vps2 = [e['handle'] for e in q2.get('structuredContent', {}).get('entities', []) 
            if e.get('space') == '*Paper_Space0' and e.get('type') == 'Viewport']
    print(f"details viewports: {vps2}")
    sheet_vp_det = vps2[0] # E9
    content_vps_det = [h for h in vps2 if h != sheet_vp_det]

    # We need exactly 2 content viewports: left (door 1:16) and right (window 1:10)
    if len(content_vps_det) < 2:
        r1 = ocs.run('MVIEW 0.012,0.010 0.138,0.198')
        vp_door = r1['structuredContent']['changes'][0]['handle']
        r2 = ocs.run('MVIEW 0.145,0.065 0.282,0.198')
        vp_win = r2['structuredContent']['changes'][0]['handle']
    else:
        vp_door = content_vps_det[0]
        vp_win = content_vps_det[1]

    print(f"Setting properties on details viewports: door={vp_door}, win={vp_win}...")
    # Left Viewport (single-door detail at 1:16 scale)
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='entities', handle=vp_door, updates=[
        {'path': '/center/x', 'value': 0.075},
        {'path': '/center/y', 'value': 0.105},
        {'path': '/width', 'value': 0.125},
        {'path': '/height', 'value': 0.180},
        {'path': '/view_target/x', 'value': 50.50},
        {'path': '/view_target/y', 'value': 0.50},
        {'path': '/view_target/z', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/x', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/y', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_height', 'value': 2.88},
        {'path': '/custom_scale', 'value': 0.0625},
        {'path': '/common/layer', 'value': 'viewport'}
    ])

    # Right Viewport (window/profile detail at 1:10 scale)
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='entities', handle=vp_win, updates=[
        {'path': '/center/x', 'value': 0.210},
        {'path': '/center/y', 'value': 0.130},
        {'path': '/width', 'value': 0.130},
        {'path': '/height', 'value': 0.130},
        {'path': '/view_target/x', 'value': 60.45},
        {'path': '/view_target/y', 'value': 0.15},
        {'path': '/view_target/z', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/x', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/y', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_height', 'value': 1.30},
        {'path': '/custom_scale', 'value': 0.10},
        {'path': '/common/layer', 'value': 'viewport'}
    ])

    # Zoom window on details sheet
    ocs.run('ZOOM W 0,0 0.30,0.22')

    # ==========================================
    # 3. PUBLISH LAYOUT1 TO example 2.pdf
    # ==========================================
    print("Publishing Layout1 to /home/ga/Documents/CAD/example 2.pdf...")
    pdf_path = '/home/ga/Documents/CAD/example 2.pdf'
    res_plot = ocs.execute('plot', path=pdf_path, layout='Layout1')
    print("Plot result:", res_plot.get('structuredContent', {}).get('result'))
    if os.path.exists(pdf_path):
        print(f"Verified: {pdf_path} created, size: {os.path.getsize(pdf_path)} bytes")
    else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, sys, os, time
from master_draft import OCS

def polish():
    ocs = OCS()
    print("OCS connection established.")

    # 1. Clean up Paper Space on Layout1
    print("Cleaning up Layout1 paper space...")
    ocs.run('-LAYOUT S Layout1')
    q1 = ocs.query(limit=2000)
    ents1 = q1.get('structuredContent', {}).get('entities', [])
    # Find duplicate text or polylines in *Paper_Space
    # Original handles are C9..CF and D4. Viewports are 3BC and 3BD.
    # Any other handle in *Paper_Space should be deleted and recreated cleanly.
    del_l1 = []
    for e in ents1:
        if e.get('space') == '*Paper_Space':
            h = e.get('handle')
            if h not in ['C9', 'CA', 'CB', 'CC', 'CD', 'CE', 'CF', 'D4', '3BC', '3BD']:
                del_l1.append(h)
    if del_l1:
        print(f"Deleting {len(del_l1)} old/duplicate entities in Layout1: {del_l1}")
        ocs.execute('entities_delete', handles=del_l1)

    # Recreate sheet border and title block texts in Layout1
    l1_clean = [
        # Sheet border
        {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': '0', 'closed': True, 'vertices': [[0.008, 0.008], [0.287, 0.008], [0.287, 0.200], [0.008, 0.200]]},
        # Title block texts
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.052], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Project: Example 1'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.039], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Location:'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.026], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Drawing name: Ground floor'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.224, 0.014], 'height': 0.0025, 'value': '1:200'}
    ]
    ocs.create_entities(l1_clean)

    # Ensure 3BD properties are exact
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='entities', handle='3BD', updates=[
        {'path': '/center/x', 'value': 0.148},
        {'path': '/center/y', 'value': 0.110},
        {'path': '/width', 'value': 0.270},
        {'path': '/height', 'value': 0.175},
        {'path': '/view_target/x', 'value': 19.15},
        {'path': '/view_target/y', 'value': 6.20},
        {'path': '/view_target/z', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/x', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_center/y', 'value': 0.0},
        {'path': '/view_height', 'value': 35.0},
        {'path': '/custom_scale', 'value': 0.005},
        {'path': '/common/layer', 'value': 'viewport'}
    ])
    ocs.select(handles=['3BD'])
    ocs.execute('property', field='frozen_layers', value='Furnitures')

    # 2. Clean up Paper Space on details
    print("Cleaning up details paper space...")
    ocs.run('-LAYOUT S details')
    q2 = ocs.query(limit=2000)
    ents2 = q2.get('structuredContent', {}).get('entities', [])
    del_det = []
    for e in ents2:
        if e.get('space') == '*Paper_Space0':
            h = e.get('handle')
            if h not in ['E9', '3BE', '3BF']:
                del_det.append(h)
    if del_det:
        print(f"Deleting {len(del_det)} old entities in details: {del_det}")
        ocs.execute('entities_delete', handles=del_det)

    det_clean = [
        # Sheet border
        {'type': 'LwPolyline', 'layer': '0', 'closed': True, 'vertices': [[0.008, 0.008], [0.287, 0.008], [0.287, 0.200], [0.008, 0.200]]},
        # Title block table lines
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.008], 'end': [0.205, 0.060]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.287, 0.008], 'end': [0.287, 0.060]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.008], 'end': [0.287, 0.008]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.022], 'end': [0.287, 0.022]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.034], 'end': [0.287, 0.034]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.047], 'end': [0.287, 0.047]},
        {'type': 'Line', 'layer': '0', 'start': [0.205, 0.060], 'end': [0.287, 0.060]},
        # Block Drawn Scale Date
        {'type': 'Insert', 'block': 'Drawn Scale Date', 'position': [0.209, 0.020], 'scale': 1.0, 'layer': '0'},
        # Title block text
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.052], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Project: Example 1'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.039], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Location:'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.207, 0.026], 'height': 0.0035, 'value': 'Drawing name: Details'},
        {'type': 'Text', 'layer': '0', 'position': [0.224, 0.014], 'height': 0.0025, 'value': 'As shown'}
    ]
    ocs.create_entities(det_clean)

    # Configure viewports in details
    # 3BE: door detail at 1:16
    ocs.execute('set_properties', collection='entities', handle='3BE', updates=[

import subprocess, json
